content.text: The ticket (t001) is a high-priority billing report from Maria that she was charged $9.99 twice for Lumen Plus, both dated the 3rd, and she asks for the duplicate to be refunded. The search found no other ticket about this same duplicate charge; the other results covered different issues, such as a $480 charge (t036), a Team plan upgrade (t019), a table-paste bug (t002), and an email change (t003).
